# Voice to Handwriting

> Free browser-based handwriting generator: speak or type a text, and get a realistic handwritten page you can export as PNG or PDF. Speech recognition and rendering run locally in your browser — your text is never uploaded. No signup.

Made for greeting cards, letters, journals and social posts, plus printable practice sheets for kids and adults. Every tool is free and works in the browser.

## Tools: write & generate

- [Handwriting Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/): the main tool — speak into the page or paste text, pick a handwriting font and paper, export PNG or PDF.
- [Cursive Writing Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/cursive): turn speech or typing into flowing cursive on lined practice paper.
- [Cursive Text Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/cursive-text-generator): cursive text you can copy and paste — thirteen Unicode styles for Instagram, TikTok and Discord bios.
- [Cursive Font Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/cursive-font-generator): preview text in thirteen open-source handwriting fonts and export PNG, SVG or PDF.
- [Handwriting Templates](https://voicetohandwriting.online/templates): love letters, apologies, thank-you notes, birthday and holiday wishes — copy, restyle and export as handwriting.
- [Printable Handwritten Letters and Envelopes](https://voicetohandwriting.online/printable-handwritten-letters): paste a recipient list and download a handwritten-style letter plus matching envelope for each person.

## Tools: practice sheets & printing

- [Name Tracing Worksheet Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/name-tracing): personalized name tracing worksheets with dashed midlines, downloadable as PDF.
- [Handwriting Worksheet Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/handwriting-worksheet-generator): printable handwriting worksheets from any word list or sentence, on three-line practice paper.
- [Printable Lined Paper Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/printable-paper): lined, graph and handwriting paper in Letter or A4, no watermark.
- [Handwriting Page Calculator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/handwriting-page-calculator): see how many sheets a handwritten text needs, by paper type and line spacing.
- [Cursive Alphabet](https://voicetohandwriting.online/cursive-alphabet): every cursive letter A to Z with start-dot stroke guides, printable as a chart.
- [Cursive Worksheets Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/cursive-worksheets): traceable cursive rows from any word list, with stroke guides.
- [Number Tracing Worksheets](https://voicetohandwriting.online/number-tracing): number tracing pages for 1–10 or 1–20, one solid row then dotted rows.
- [Writing Practice Sheet Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/writing-practice): practice sheets for Chinese, Japanese and Korean — tianzige squares, genkō yōshi grids and hangul cells.
- [Name Coloring Page Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/name-coloring): printable bubble-letter coloring pages for any name.
- [Handwriting Workbook Generator](https://voicetohandwriting.online/handwriting-workbook-generator): a printable workbook PDF with cover page, word list and traceable rows.
- [Handwriting Personality Test](https://voicetohandwriting.online/handwriting-personality-quiz): a fun 12-question quiz about your handwriting, with practice tips.
